ModMetadata.Name: PainterPro
ModMetadata.Author: jweisner
ModMetadata.Description: Hold Shift while painting to colour an entire pipe, cable, chute, or robotic arm rail network at once. Ctrl paints a checkered/alternating pattern across the network, useful for marking a gas mix. Painting normally affects only the item you spray. Works in multiplayer. Inspired by NetworkPainter by Elmotrix.
